temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days during a busy, stressful week at the bank; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is acting unlike her normally engaging self, and something may be wrong or troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn confirms that she is overwhelmed by work and personal matters, so Carolyn's concern is validated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling with work and personal issues, but she is willing to acknowledge it rather than completely shut Carolyn out.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk if she wants to.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes, and says she has had a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn may have been offended by Carolyn's concern or may be distancing herself; her curtness feels confusing and slightly hurtful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn clarifies that her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily Carolyn's overstep.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's response was not personal rejection; she appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: relieved and reassured, with lingering empathy
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up the misunderstanding and continue supporting Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small get-together; Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks Carolyn, and accepts the invitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, and their friendship seems to be developing; Marilyn may be open to social connection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn's acceptance confirms her interest in spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn wants to strengthen the friendship, and Carolyn's hope for their bond is justified.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and build the friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn raises the perceived professional distance at the bank; Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn remains professionally distant at the bank, and the distance is disappointing and unexplained.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn did not intend the distance and is willing to discuss and improve their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The professional distance may be resolvable, and Marilyn is open to addressing it rather than avoiding the issue.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: initially disappointed, then cautiously relieved and hopeful
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal; Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had their talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: They have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; collaboration should improve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement reinforces that their professional relationship is stronger and mutually collaborative.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is genuinely willing to partner on the project, and their working relationship is now more positive and collaborative.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and continue building their partnership.
